question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e.** 'Build'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** sentence is describing **an activity where Arizona State University students are working together to create something, specifically portable air purifiers for local schools.
 
• Among the given options, **"build"** is the most appropriate word, as it means to construct or assemble something. In this context, the students are aiming to construct or "build" 125 portable air purifiers.
 
• The term **"build**" directly relates to the action of assembling or creating a tangible object, making it the logical choice for this sentence.
 
• **Other options like** "beat," "weld," or "sieve" do not fit the context of the sentence, as they describe unrelated actions.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: * 'One afternoon, a dozen Arizona State University students gathered to spend the morning cutting cardboard, taping fans and assembling filters in an effort to **build **125 portable air purifiers for local schools. That (3)_______ morning, staff members at a homeless shelter in Los Angeles were setting (4)_______ 20 homemade purifiers of their own, while in Brookline, Massachusetts, another DIY air purifier was whirring quietly in the back of a day care (5)______ as children played.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Beat **(पीटना) - Refers to striking repeatedly; not relevant here.
 
• **Weld **(वेल्ड) - Refers to joining metals by heating the edges and hammering or pressing them together; doesn’t fit the context.
 
• **Sieve** (छानना) - Refers to a process of separating or sifting; irrelevant in this context.
